title: Duckling with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyG' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE45C'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#F5C400'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='eyeG' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFFFFF'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#BFE8FF'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='30' ry='24' fill='url(#bodyG)'/>
  <!-- body shading edge -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='27' ry='16' fill='#FFDA3A' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- wing -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='68' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#EBAE00' transform='rotate(-15 72 68)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='66' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#FFD84D' transform='rotate(-15 70 66)'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='22' fill='url(#bodyG)'/>
  <!-- tuft -->
  <path d='M50 17 Q46 8 52 10 Q56 12 53 18 Q50 16 47 20 Q49 15 50 17' fill='#F5C400'/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='44' r='4.5' fill='#FF9E9E' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='44' r='4.5' fill='#FF9E9E' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='36' r='6.5' fill='url(#eyeG)'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='36' r='6.5' fill='url(#eyeG)'/>
  <!-- pupils -->
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='37' r='3.2' fill='#3B2A8C'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='37' r='3.2' fill='#3B2A8C'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='33.5' r='1.6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='33.5' r='1.6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='39' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='39' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M42 46 Q50 42 58 46 Q55 53 50 54 Q45 53 42 46 Z' fill='#FF9A1F'/>
  <path d='M43 47 Q50 45 57 47 Q54 50 50 50.5 Q46 50 43 47 Z' fill='#FFC060'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='47.5' cy='45.6' r='0.8' fill='#D96E00'/>
  <circle cx='52.5' cy='45.6' r='0.8' fill='#D96E00'/>

  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M36 86 L28 92 L36 90 L40 92 Z' fill='#FF9A1F'/>
  <path d='M64 86 L72 92 L64 90 L60 92 Z' fill='#FF9A1F'/>
</svg>
